Description: Frames are internally scaled in NvTracker plugin to the specified resolution for tracking and passed to the low-level lib
Supports tracking on batched buffers consisting of frames from multiple sources
User can select GPU for internal scaling/color format conversions and tracking

Feature: Dynamic addition/deletion of sources at runtime
Description: Supports tracking on new sources added at runtime and cleanup of resources when sources are removed

Feature: Support for user’s choice of low-level library
Description: Dynamically loads user selected low-level library
Supports sending frames from multiple input streams to the low-level library

Feature: Multiple buffer formats as input to low-level library
Description: Converts input buffer to formats requested by the low-level library, for up to 4 formats per frame
Supports enabling or disabling display of tracking-id

Feature: Tracking ID reset based on event
Description: Based on the pipeline event (i.e., GST_NVEVENT_STREAM_EOS and GST_NVEVENT_STREAM_RESET),  the tracking IDs on a particular stream can be reset to start from 0 or new IDs.
Supports outputting user defined miscellaneous data (including object Re-ID features, the past-frame data, a list of terminated tracks, etc. ) if the low-level library supports the capability

Feature: Support for NVIDIA's `VPI™ <https://docs.nvidia.com/vpi/index.html>`_ based Crop-scaler and DCF-Tracker algorithms in NvDCF tracker
Description: "Configuration options provided in NvDCF tracker which allow the user to switch to NVIDIA's `VPI™ <https://docs.nvidia.com/vpi/index.html>`_ implementation of Crop-scaler and DCF-Tracker. The user can also configure the compute backend to be used amongst the backends supported by `VPI™ <https://docs.nvidia.com/vpi/index.html>`_"

Feature: PVA-backend for NvDCF via `VPI™ <https://docs.nvidia.com/vpi/index.html>`_'s unified API
Description: Allow PVA-based execution of a significant part of NvDCF on Jetson to achieve lower GPU utilization

Supports splitting of a batch of frames in sub-batches which are internally processed in parallel resulting in higher resource utilization. This feature also enables specification of a different config file for each sub-batch.
Allow 3D world coordinate system based object tracking when camera/model info (3x4 projection matrix and 3D human model info) is provided for better handling of partial occlusion
A new algorithm for multi-object tracking and segmentation using SAM2 as visual tracking engine
